regime_context: The detector shows a narrowing, five-theme eligible universe in Hong Kong where Banks (H + HK) leads on a modest margin over Energy (H-shares), with absolute-trend eligibility true for only 29% of themes. Cross-sectional rank is attention-only (rank-IC ~0), but the absolute-trend gate is validated as risk control on this market, and the ledger is 25/26 with no dominant one-narrative structure.
emerging_watch: Watching whether the Banks-to-Energy handoff confirms: if Energy (H-shares) closes the 0.184 score gap to Banks (H + HK) and takes rank-1 for two consecutive weeks while Banks' durability_bar drops below 0.5, the leadership rotation is confirmed rather than just a narrowing challenge.

theses.subject: Energy (H-shares)
theses.thesis: Energy is eligible, trend-anchored (hurst_tag trend, durability_bar 0.80), and shows the strongest breadth (0.90) of any eligible theme — cohesion across constituents. It is the only challenger close to the leader and is NOT crowded (z 0.24). The trend-gate leg supports staying power with lower drawdown risk; the durability + breadth legs support it as a resilient leadership candidate.
evidence: rank=2 with score=1.153, closest challenger to leader
theses.dissent: The absolute-trend gate has no mean-return edge; it reduces volatility but does not imply Energy will outperform. A crude-linked macro shock could reverse H-share energy names quickly even with trend intact.

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks are the leader and eligible, with mixed but positive durability (0.63) and reasonable breadth (0.615). The leader is NOT crowded and is not a one-narrative blowoff, so the leadership is genuine but not reflexive-fragile. Trend-gate eligibility plus rank-1 status supports keeping exposure, though the margin over Energy is small (0.184).
theses.dissent: The thin margin over Energy and mixed hurst_tag mean leadership could hand over quickly; if the rotation handoff completes, Banks could lag despite current rank-1. Fading the leader is a documented failure mode, but so is assuming rank persistence.

falsifier.text: Banks (H + HK) loses rank-1 to Energy (H-shares) with a margin greater than 0.2 before the check-by date
